about: Per-fact rises of the uncertifiable count on existing fixtures (ADR 0955; scripts/guard/rises.mjs). A veto or a fail-closed change raises the count on purpose; a row here names the fixture, the `code blocker` key, the counts, the ADR and the typed fact (hazards, formula or missing fact) that did it. Named, never blocked: an unnamed rise is printed, not a failure. Append-only; counts.json is not rekeyed.

rises.fact: the follow-ups of the re-check of #225 (N1, N2) pin sites that stay uncertifiable and are never silenced: a Show function child with a default or rest parameter (Function.length 0, so Show returns it and whoever reads the Show calls it), an auto-accessor field's initializer (instance-field-initializer), an Errored fallback that reads arguments (the entry walk does not close it: entry-by-reference), and the getter rows of the component-child Show elements (getter-runs-where-read)
